newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma cut to hold.

text.p: -- Lazard Freres & Co said on Wednesday it lowered its rating for Brazilian brewer Companhia Cervejaria Brahma to hold from buy.

-- "We are lowering our earnings per share estimates to $33.15, $35.45 and $40.25 from $47 for 1996, $52 for 1997 and $57.74 for 1998, and are lowering our rating to hold from buy," analysts Brian Barish and Julie Ko wrote in a report.

"... We believe that the factors which caused the company's margins to compress in the third quarter will persist for some time to come, and in addition we are concerned by the potential impact of substantial idle capacity once Brahma's new facilities in Rio de Janeiro are operating."
